sn35.165:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn35.165:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.165:1.3: kathannu kho bhante jānato kathaṃ passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatīti?
sn35.165:2.1: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.165:2.2: rūpe aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.165:2.3: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.165:2.4: cakkhusamphassaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati. yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati. sotaṃ aniccato …pe… ghānaṃ …pe… jivhaṃ …pe… kāyaṃ …pe… manaṃ aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati. dhamme aniccato …pe… manoviññāṇaṃ …pe… manosamphassaṃ …pe…
sn35.165:2.5: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyati.
sn35.165:2.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato micchādiṭṭhi pahīyatīti.
